$comment: The least-privilege application-permission set the launch Graph transport requires — the record a tenant admin consents from. Derived from the connector's real requests (see README table); recorded 2026-08-21, IdentityRiskyUser.Read.All added 2026-10-08. Held to the connector by scripts/check-graph-permission-boundary.mjs in both directions: a permission or usedBy entry the connector never needs, or a connector read or scope missing here, fails the gate. Adding a permission here without a matching connector call is the drift this file exists to make visible.

application.why: read-only device posture — the DeviceManagementEvidence source
identity enablement only; $select limits the read to the three fields the engine consumes
user risk, joined to /users by id; without it Graph answers 403 and every subject grades userRisk unknown (never none)

notRequested: No write, no wipe, no retire, no beta endpoints — the connector is read-only by doctrine (lab registry: mutationsAllowed false).
